source: Honest Cattle Market Index v2.2 — named CME GF/LE contract settlements (nearest listed month after the priced week, settled inside that week) + USDA AMS_1778 head-weighted; base 2024 = 100; provisional prints carry Montana legs at last USDA print; forward curve from transacted prices only
basis_note: Spot futures legs price off the named contract in components.feeder_gf.contract / components.live_le.contract, settled on the stated date. Prints before the week ending 2026-10-24 were built on a rolled continuous front-month series and are on a slightly different basis; the 2024 base is unchanged.
note: Provisional: AMS_1778 for this week not yet published; Montana steer and boning-cow legs carried at last USDA print. Reconciles when USDA posts.

forward.convention: Transacted prices only: deferred CME GF/LE settles; MT steer leg from forward-delivery video-auction sales (600-649 lb M&L1 steers, delivery-start-month buckets) within 60 days, else carried; boning leg carried (no forward cull market). No Honest Cattle estimates in any leg.

steer_leg_sources.video MT 600-649: Preferred. Built lot by lot from the auction houses' own results (Northern Livestock, Superior, Western Video Market) and filtered to lots with a published Montana shipping or delivery point. Genuinely Montana-only.
steer_leg_sources.video 600-649: Fallback. Parsed from the USDA AMS video report, which pools Montana into North Central (CO, IA, MT, ND, NE, SD, WY) and cannot be filtered to state of origin. Flagged with a caveat wherever used.
steer_leg_sources.carry: No forward-delivery lots for the month; last USDA cash print carried.

mt_steer.region: North Central (CO, IA, MT, ND, NE, SD, WY)
mt_steer.caveat: AMS-derived: Montana is pooled with six other states in this figure. Used only because no Montana-only lots were available for this delivery month.
